offering_description.value: Provides education services to private universities, chiefly Grand Canyon University, its largest client. Services include technology, academic and student support, marketing and enrollment support, and campus facilities, delivered under long-term contracts for a share of university revenue.

primary_services.value: university marketing and enrollment support; technology and IT services; academic support and faculty recruitment; student services and counseling; campus facilities and classroom support

customer_segment.value: B2B: private, nonprofit universities, mainly Grand Canyon University, plus other partner institutions

end_markets.value: higher education; online education; nursing and healthcare education

revenue_model.value: service fees: percentage of partner university tuition and fee revenue under long-term master services agreements

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in university needs and delivers outsourced operating, marketing and technology services to partner universities

geography_served.value: US national: Based in Phoenix, Arizona, supports a university with on-campus and online students across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: bundled education services: marketing, technology, academic support, student services and facilities for universities

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: long-term contracts directly with partner universities

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Indirect exposure via Title IV federal student aid rules, Department of Education and accreditor oversight of partner universities

notes: Largely dependent on Grand Canyon University; other partners are smaller.
